decode_policy.output: association edges and connected components only; no merged interval is emitted

M2.real_truth_gap: no verified insertion-level ground truth supplied in Phase0
M2.requires: verified model edge scores and an approved training/evaluation split

M3.real_truth_gap: no verified biological fragment-to-insertion linkage truth supplied in Phase0
M3.requires: context-aware sequence evidence and an independent truth panel

prediction_namespace.predicted_family: feature supplied by a detector; null means unknown
prediction_namespace.predicted_length: positive detector feature; not substituted with interval length
prediction_namespace.predicted_orientation: feature supplied by a detector; null means unknown

split_contract.family_group: family_group_id; all rows in one family group stay in one split
split_contract.note: source-copy and family-group split assignments are emitted separately
split_contract.pair_gate: a role-specific edge may enter a role only when both endpoints share that role; otherwise EXCLUDED_CROSS_SPLIT
split_contract.source_copy_group: source_copy_id; all fragments from one source copy stay in one split

truth_namespace.parent_insertion_id: independent insertion identity; null only when truth_status=unresolved
truth_namespace.truth_same_insertion: null whenever either endpoint is unresolved
